title: Seating Chart Family Balance Gaps
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:seating family_group=* balanced=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(balanced="no",1,0))) as matched by family_group
| eval an_imbalance_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_imbalance_pct
description: Measures the percentage of seating groups that end with an imbalance by family group.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which family group are helping or hurting seating groups.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an imbalance` on `event:seating` events and summarize the hit rate by `family_group`.
visualization: Table of family group with percentage of seating groups ending with an imbalance.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often an imbalance happens for each family group so you can see where seating groups go smoothly or get stuck.
